name: zstd
description: Fast lossless compression algorithm with high compression ratios and rapid decompression

tools.description: High-performance compression tool with excellent speed-to-compression ratio balance
tools.usage:
zstd file.txt # Compress file (creates file.txt.zst)
zstd -d file.txt.zst # Decompress file
zstd -19 file.txt # Maximum compression level
zstd -c file.txt > compressed.zst # Compress to stdout
zstd -r directory/ # Compress directory recursively
